title: Starweave Mage / 星絨法師：自走遠征

assets.source: Created specifically for this game. Original world-anchored procedural terrain, deterministic bounded tile cache, five illustrated biomes, a northeast expedition trail, a persistent tent, characters, equipment icons and effects. All visual geometry is original; no external media dependencies. V3 adds a 15-body creature drawing system with 50 normal species and 10 distinct boss designs. Every catalog entry has an original body/appendage/ornament combination; every boss has a bespoke scene accessory. Patterned world-space circle, ring, line and cone telegraphs are drawn under actors and clipped out of the southwest escape strip. Small coral hostile shots are separate from friendly magic.

Created specifically for this game. Original SVG cover artwork matching the centered mage, northeast woodland trail, southwest tent and three-direction enemy approach. Uses generic local system serif and sans-serif fonts.

assets.type: original creature catalog and anatomy descriptions
assets.source: 60 original named creatures written for Starweave. Creature anatomy and art are original procedural geometry; no third-party characters or media.

motion: Reduced-motion rendering freezes creature gaits, decorative appendage animation, and telegraph dash motion. All 60 creatures produce byte-identical images at different times in reduced-motion mode; essential state, telegraph countdowns, combat effects and actual world movement remain visible.
worldRendering: World coordinates drive one shared camera transform for terrain, camp, enemies, projectiles, loot and the mage. Terrain and route details are indexed by stable world coordinates; only visible cells are drawn and the tile cache is capped at 48 tiles. No fixed arena, portal or basket artwork.

creatureArt.signature: All 60 are distinct after replacing every palette with the same four colors; thresholded alpha silhouette masks are also all distinct.
creatureArt.galleryAPI: StarweaveRender.drawCreature(ctx, definition, x, y, size=64, time=0, options={reducedMotion:false}); x/y are ground anchors and size is nominal pixels.
creatureArt.originality: Original Canvas 2D vector paths and shapes only. No copyrighted character references, external illustrations, imported image assets, or recolor-only species.

verification.method: Offline @napi-rs/canvas; no browser; all 60 catalog creatures rendered with production drawCreature; six production world samples; cone half-angle boundary regression against engine.hazardContains and production raster; 240 timed cached frames after 40 warm-up frames.

renderPerformance.scope: Node native Canvas CPU benchmark; not a browser/mobile frame-rate claim
